verdict.scope_summary: All four atomic stability requirements landed: comparable-run swing detection, bounded scenario re-runs, retained attempt variance, and explicit unstable scorecard marking without silent averaging. The largest in-scope effect is the new 5a/5b stability subsystem with scheduler feedback, scorecard output, and audit retention. Most geometry changes are necessary accommodations that expand section 5 and shift the two lower sections intact. The sole collateral effect is replacement of the comparison-rule prose, which drops prior explanatory wording about assembler merging, chosen-baseline comparison, and threshold narration; the existing nodes and connections preserve that architecture, so the impact is minor.
